# Run enhanced heteroscedasticity diagnostics

<small>Source: [`R/robust_implementations.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/robust_implementations.R) · Help: `?runAdvancedDiagnostics`</small>

Executes one or more robust diagnostics with automatic enhancements for
small samples and optional studentisation.

## Usage

```r
runAdvancedDiagnostics(
  model,
  data,
  tests = "all",
  auto_enhance = TRUE,
  bootstrap_B = 999,
  parallel = FALSE,
  ci_level = 0.95
)

rrunAdvancedDiagnostics(
  model,
  data,
  tests = "all",
  auto_enhance = TRUE,
  bootstrap_B = 999,
  parallel = FALSE,
  ci_level = 0.95
)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted [stats::lm](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/lm.html) object representing the mean specification
    to be diagnosed.

`data`
:   A [base::data.frame](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html) (or object coercible to one) containing the
    variables referenced by `model`. It must include the observations used to
    fit `model` and will be checked for missing values.

`tests`
:   Character vector of tests to run. Use "all" (default) to
    run the White and Breusch-Pagan diagnostics, or supply a subset such
    as `c("white", "bp")`.

`auto_enhance`
:   Logical, enable automatic bootstrap for small
    samples (n &lt; 50) and studentization for Breusch-Pagan.

`bootstrap_B`
:   Number of bootstrap replications used when automatic
    enhancement triggers bootstrap. Defaults to 999, the default of every
    resampling test in the package since 0.15.0; it was 500 before. On a fit
    returned by [`fitWLS()`](fitWLS.md) the bootstrap of [`performWhiteTestRobust()`](performWhiteTestRobust.md) and
    [`performBPTestRobust()`](performBPTestRobust.md) estimates the weights again in each replicate, the
    default of [`bootstrapTestStatistic()`](rbootstrap_test_statistic.md) since 0.15.0, and there is no
    argument to hold them fixed here.

`parallel`
:   Logical, allow parallel bootstrap evaluation when the
    `parallel` package is available. A seeded call gives the same result
    each time; see *Parallel replicates* in [`bootstrapTestStatistic()`](rbootstrap_test_statistic.md).

`ci_level`
:   Confidence level for reported intervals.

## Value

A list with the executed results and metadata describing the
enhancements that were applied.

## Deprecated name

`rrunAdvancedDiagnostics()` is deprecated since 0.15.0: use
`runAdvancedDiagnostics()`, the same function under the package's naming
scheme. The old name still works, returns what it returned and warns; it
leaves the exports in 1.0.0.
